title: MarkFlow Phase-2 Feature Flags
description: Machine-readable phase-2 feature flag registry. Each flag records its id, milestone stage, default value, fallback behavior, deletion time, and owning child change. Rollback is restricted to exact source projection: serializer, DOM-save and ProseMirror fallbacks are forbidden.

deleteAfter.description: Deletion time as a milestone name or YYYY-MM-DD date. Flags whose date has passed must be removed.
